4e083d72-54ee-596f-8c22-61949a4be826.content: After finishing an errand at a nearby government office, I had some time left and stopped by with my family.

5b849804-3fb2-5f92-88e6-d5c869a1c223.content: The dessert display showed only prices, so I did not know what the desserts were called, but the one I chose was delicious.

d3f922a7-5038-5646-8b9a-273b7f716cf5.content: The coffee was also really delicious.

d5fc7c83-487b-5b3b-bc62-22e1a41e72cf.content: I had to get a key to use the restroom, and it smelled a little, but the building was old, so it seemed unavoidable.

ddcc08c6-a7a2-525d-b467-eba90de4aca0.content: The takeaway cup was pretty and felt really good to hold.
